question: #12496 at 851a97e1: does each Slider keep one track length across every value and during a mouse drag, in every bundled theme body font?

method.conditions: light and dark (Storybook global colorMode and the page color scheme) x LTR and RTL (global direction)

sliders.Price range: core-slider--range with label Price range, 0 to 1000, step 10, valueDisplay text
sliders.Blend: core-slider--custom-step with label Blend, 0 to 0.8, step 0.1
sliders.Opacity: core-slider--custom-step with label Opacity, 0 to 1, step 0.1
sliders.Rating: core-slider--with-format-value with label Rating, 1 to 5, step 1, and words

method.argsNote: Price range, Blend, Opacity and Rating get their props through the Storybook preview, on both builds, so both draw the same slider
method.fonts: each theme's own fonts.css faces for its body family, injected as data URLs (Storybook loads no theme font); default (as served) injects nothing
method.values: Home, then ArrowUp to the end, reading the track after each step; a range sweeps the upper thumb, then the lower one
method.drag: a real mouse drag: press on the thumb, move past one end of the track in 40 steps, then past the other end in 80 steps, release; the track is read on every animation frame
method.track: the width of the slider control element (.astryx-slider-control)
method.clipped: the value text's box scrolls, or its glyphs pass its box by more than 0.5 px
method.dragNote: Each drag moves the pointer 40 times to past one end, then 80 times to past the other; the track is read on every animation frame in between.
method.samples: drags[].samples: [ms since the page started, track width px, the dragged thumb's value] per animation frame
